title: English Practice Quiz 0385
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The test was ___ than I expected.
You ___ wear your identity card at work.
questions.explanation: Modal verbs such as should are followed by the base verb without to.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Because I was tired, I went to bed early.
Because I tired, went bed early.
I because was tired bed early.
Because tired I went early bed.
questions.explanation: The subordinate clause beginning with because explains the reason.

questions.question: You have completed a task. You say:
questions.explanation: The task is complete is a clear status update.

questions.question: If it rains, we ___ indoors.
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses if + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.question: ___ student must bring an ID card.
questions.explanation: Each refers to every individual in a group.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
questions.explanation: The comparative form of the short adjective tall is taller.

questions.question: A place where medicines are dispensed is a ___.
questions.explanation: A pharmacy is a place where medicines are prepared or supplied.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.
